title: Eddoboozi ly’Okukakasa Okukwekebwa
intro: Mu mutima gw’olubiri olutyoboola, ng’obutakkiriza bwe tteeka ly’ensi, emmeeme eyali yokka yatambuliranga ku muguwa omunywevu ogw’okukkiriza n’okutya. Ono ssekinnoomu, okumpi n’amasekkati g’obuyinza, yawuliriza ng’obubaka bwa nnabbi busisinkanibwa okunyoomebwa n’okutiisatiisa. Akaseera ak’amazima kaatuuka, ne kawaliriza omuntu ono okulonda wakati w’obukuumi obusirise n’okwogera amazima ag’akabi. Osobola okuzuula omuntu ono omuvumu omuwolereza?
clues: Nnabeera mu maka gennyini ag’omutyobooli, nga ndaba n’amaaso amalala agaali gagaana obubonero obw’obwakatonda.
Okukkiriza kwange nnakukuuma nga kyama, eky’obugagga ekikusike mu lubiri olw’okusinza ebifaananyi.
Nawulira omukulembeze gwe naweereza ng’akola olukwe lw’okutta omubaka wa Allah, omusajja ayitibwa Musa.
Nabuusabuusa ensonga zaabwe, nga mbajjukiza enkomerero y’abantu ba Nuh, ‘Ad, ne Thamud.
Nabuuza abantu bange ekibuuzo ekikulu: ‘Bw’aba mulimba, obulimba bwe buli ku ye; naye bw’aba wa mazima, ebimu ku by’asuubiza bijja kukukuba.’
Emboozi yange eyogerwako ng’ekyokulabirako eky’okukkiriza mu suura etuumiddwa ‘Omusonyiwa,’ gye nnalabula abantu bange ku nkwe z’ab’amaanyi.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
